# How much Statutory Sick Pay do you owe for this absence?

> Free UK SSP calculator for 2026/27: enter average weekly earnings, qualifying days and sickness dates to see the weekly and daily rate, days paid and total SSP due, including the 6 April 2026 change. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
